thread:
marta: Partner ACME-SI + Nebula (HW) requested a compliance bundle to push the joint offer to Azure Marketplace by next Tue. Required: SOC2 Type II (redacted), pen-test executive summary, completed vendor questionnaire, sanitized network diagram, and an artifacts index. Who can own each?
logan: I can do the sanitized diagram + redaction. Need a checklist of what to redact (IPs, customer names, internal IDs). Any template?
carla: I'll pull the pen-test exec summary from Cobalt and extract top findings. We only share exec summary + index (no raw logs). Legal sign-off needed on wording.
samir: I can handle the SOC2 PDF upload. Question: full report vs attestation letter? Marketplace review usually requests the full SOC2 (with PII redacted).
marta: Marketplace policy = full SOC2 Type II (redacted PII) + pen-test exec summary. Also need the vendor questionnaire completed. Legal review required before submission.
joe_si: ACME-SI will attach a short HW security statement and host an S3 presigned bundle for retrieval.
marketplace-bot: :package: New JIRA MPART-4521 created for "ACME-SI + Nebula marketplace compliance bundle" assigned to partnerships. Due in 5 days.
marta: Proposed ownership: SOC2 -> samir; pen-test exec -> carla; questionnaire + legal loop -> marta; sanitized diagram -> logan; artifact index + presign handling -> joe_si. Ack?
logan: ack. Redaction checklist: remove internal hostnames, mask IPs to /24, strip MACs, remove screenshots with customer data. I'll upload to s3://marketplace-evidence/MPART-4521/diagrams/ (need presign).
carla: ack. Will redact PoCs and include mitigations and timelines. Draft by EOD tomorrow.
samir: ack. Need KMS key name and presign TTL. Marketplace prefers 72h. Who controls final file naming?
marta: KMS key: mp-marketplace-evidence. Presign TTL: 72h. File naming convention: <marketplace-id>_<artifact_type>_<YYYYMMDD>. Example: mp-8891_SOC2_20240315.pdf. Listing id: mp-8891.
joe_si: Temporary presign link: https://s3-presign.example/MPART-4521-bundle (TTL 72h). We'll rotate per upload.
carla: Q — do reviewers want pen-test scope? Include a one-paragraph scope in the exec summary and a scope table in the artifact index. No raw scan outputs.
logan: diagram needs a caption explaining what was redacted and why. I'll add a short caption file.
samir: looping infra and tagging infra-oncall. Creating subtask for upload steps with exact S3 paths and KMS policy.
marketplace-bot: :calendar: Reminder: "MPART-4521 compliance sync" Thu 10:00.
marta: Timeline: drafts due EOD tomorrow (diagram, pen summary); SOC2 redaction in 48h; final bundle assembled and presigned by Mon EOD; legal review Mon night; submit Tue morning. Flag now if blocked.
joe_si: ACME-SI to provide questionnaire answers by tomorrow noon and a HW attestation PDF.
carla: I'll keep redaction conservative to avoid rework.
logan: will add caption + redaction notes. Need infra confirmation to mask diagram blocks. @samir can you loop infra?
samir: infra looped. Also set a subtask for upload with exact S3 keys and KMS policy.
marta: I'll own questionnaire and legal sign-off. Posting final upload checklist to MPART-4521 once files are ready. :thumbsup:
joe_si: ACME-SI standing by for clarifications.
marketplace-bot: :white_check_mark: Thread archived into partnerships channel log.
